abstract:
BACKGROUND/AIM: Although lymph node metastasis is a negative prognostic factor in pancreatic cancer, the significance of non-metastatic lymph node enlargement remains unclear. This study evaluated the prognostic impact of the No. 8 lymph node (N8LN), which is routinely assessed during pancreaticoduodenectomy and identifiable on preoperative imaging.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed 99 patients who underwent pancreaticoduodenectomy for pancreatic cancer between 2009 and 2019. The size of the N8LN was measured on preoperative imaging, and patients were divided into small and large groups based on the median value. Long-term oncologic outcomes were compared between the two groups. To assess the local immune response, CD8 immunohistochemistry was performed on nodal sections, and CD8⁺ T-cell density was quantified using QuPath software.
RESULTS: The large group showed significantly longer progression-free survival (19.7 vs. 9.4 months) and disease-specific survival (41.7 vs. 17.1 months) than the small group. Enlarged N8LN remained an independent favorable prognostic factor in multivariable analysis. CD8⁺ T-cell density did not differ between groups.
CONCLUSION: Enlarged N8LN size was independently associated with better survival after pancreaticoduodenectomy. Nodal enlargement may reflect host immune activity rather than tumor progression and merits further investigation.
key_points_ko: 8번 임파선 크기가 큰 그룹의 무진행 생존기간(PFS)은 19.7개월로 작은 그룹(9.4개월)에 비해 길었습니다.
8번 임파선 크기가 큰 그룹의 질환 특이 생존기간(DSS)은 41.7개월로 작은 그룹(17.1개월)보다 길었습니다.
수술 전 영상에서 확인된 비전이성 8번 임파선 비대는 독립적인 양호한 예후 예측 인자로 나타났습니다.
summary_ko: 췌장암으로 췌두부십이지장절제술(pancreaticoduodenectomy)을 받은 환자 99명을 대상으로 비전이성 8번 임파선(N8LN) 크기와 예후의 연관성을 분석한 연구입니다. 수술 전 영상 검사에서 8번 임파선 크기가 더 컸던 환자군은 작은 환자군에 비해 무진행 생존기간(PFS)과 질환 특이 생존기간(DSS)이 크게 연장되었습니다. 다변량 분석 결과 8번 임파선 비대는 독립적인 양호한 예후 인자로 확인되었습니다. 이는 임파선 비대가 암의 진행보다는 환자 자체의 면역 활동을 반영할 가능성을 시사합니다.
title: Larger Non-metastatic No. 8 Lymph Node Size Is Associated With Favorable Prognosis After Pancreaticoduodenectomy for Pancreatic Cancer
title_ko: 췌장암 췌두부십이지장절제술 후 비전이성 8번 임파선 크기와 양호한 예후의 연관성
